(SANJAY AND 3 OTHERS AND OTHERS Vs THE STATE OF MADHYA P  Dated : 21-07-2023  Shri Nilesh Patel - Advocate appearing on behalf of Sh  Kumar Sharma - Advocate for appellant No.3.
 Shri Amit Rawal - Government Advocate for respondent/

Also heard on I.A. No.4703 of 2023 which is fourth application under Section 389(1) of Code of Criminal Procedure, 1973 for suspension of remaining jail sentence and grant of bail filed on behalf of appellant No.3 Pramila Pathrod.
2. The appellant has been convicted under Section 302 and 498A of IPC and sentenced to undergo Life Imprisonment with fine of Rs.700/- and 3 years R.I. with fine of Rs.300/- with default stipulation.
3. Learned counsel for the appellant submits that this repeat application has been filed only on the ground that the appellant No.3 has completed 12 years jail as on 03.05.2012.
She is not having any criminal past.
Main accused is the mother-in-law, who is already in jail.

This appeal is of the year 2012 and is not likely to be heard finally in near future and it would take sufficient long time,
therefore, prays for suspension of jail sentence of appellant and to release her on bail.
4. Learned Government Advocate for the respondent/State opposes the aforesaid application and prays for its rejection.

5. Heard learned counsel for both the parties.
6.
In view of the above facts and circumstances of the case in totality, without commenting anything on the merits of the case, we deem it proper to suspend the remaining jail sentence of appellant.
7. Accordingly I.A. No.4703 of 2023 is allowed.

It is directed that the jail sentence of the appellant shall remain suspended and she be released on bail upon her depositing the fine amount (if not already deposited) and also upon furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial Court for her Sanjay And 3 Others vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 July, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/80689492/
1 appearance before the concerned trial Court on 12.12.2023 and on such further dates as may be fixed in this behalf by the concerned trial Court during the pendency of this appeal.
